source: nflverse-data releases: draft_picks, players, combine, contracts (OverTheCap), rosters, stats_player
note: Regular seasons. Ages at September 1 of the season. Careers counted from the seasonal rosters (any status listed that season, practice squad and reserve lists included).

career_by_round.years: draft classes 1980-2015 (seasons = last season played minus draft year plus one; players still active count to 2025)

draft_by_college.file: nfl_draft_by_college.csv (picks, first-rounders and top-100 picks per college per draft)

compensatory_picks.years: 1994-2026, taken as the picks past the 32nd in rounds 3-7 (close: a forfeited pick shifts it by one)

roster_careers.years: players first on a roster 2000-2015, seasons on any roster through 2025

last_season_age.years: players whose last roster season was 2000-2020 (age at September 1 of that season)

position_changes.years: drafted 2000-2020: drafted position against the position listed most often on NFL rosters

birth_months.note: for the relative-age check; compare with US births by month (CDC, not reachable here: about 8.0-8.9% a month, August highest)

contracts.years: signed 2006-2025 (OverTheCap via nflverse; early years thin)

season_lines.note: regulars: QB 224+ attempts, backs 100+ carries, receivers 50+ targets, defenders 8+ games, kickers 15+ FG tries, punters 30+ punts

fantasy_ppr.note: full-PPR points of the 1st, 6th, 12th and 24th best player at each position
